title: How should data minimisation apply to world models?
summary: Collect cautiously during development, then retain only what is demonstrably necessary.
body: The paper recommends staged data minimisation because useful fields may not be fully known during simulator development. Once validated, systems should retain raw sensor data only when necessary for validation and delete unnecessary elements, while avoiding persistent physical-world tracking.
